NOPOLIEX constructor, mints 1000000 * 10**decimals to msg.sender and sets owner = msg.sender
NOPOLIEX.activateOwnerBurn() public, requires owner == msg.sender then sets canBurn = true
NOPOLIEX.transfer(address to,uint256 amount) public override, burns part of amount then calls super.transfer
NOPOLIEX.transferFrom(address from,address to,uint256 amount) public override, burns part from sender then calls super.transferFrom
NOPOLIEX._partialBurn(uint256 amount) internal, owner bypass check, computes burnAmount and burns from msg.sender
NOPOLIEX._partialBurnTransferFrom(address _originalSender,uint256 amount) internal, burns from the original sender without owner check
